---
title: "Buffy"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
photos <- list.files("buffy_photos",
                     pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|JPG|JPEG|PNG|GIF)$",
                     full.names = FALSE)
```

```{r slideshow, results='asis'}
if (length(photos) == 0) {
  cat('<p class="text-center" style="margin-top:3em; color:#8b5e5e;">
        No photos found — add images to the <code>buffy_photos/</code> folder and re-render.
      </p>\n')
} else {
  cat('<div class="buffy-outer">\n')
  cat('  <div class="buffy-container" id="buffyContainer">\n')
  for (i in seq_along(photos)) {
    cls <- if (i == 1) "buffy-slide active" else "buffy-slide"
    cat(sprintf('    <img src="buffy_photos/%s" class="%s" alt="Buffy photo %d">\n',
                photos[i], cls, i))
  }
  cat('  </div>\n')
  cat('  <button class="buffy-btn buffy-prev" onclick="buffyPrev()">&#10094;</button>\n')
  cat('  <button class="buffy-btn buffy-next" onclick="buffyNext()">&#10095;</button>\n')
  cat('  <div class="buffy-dots">\n')
  for (i in seq_along(photos)) {
    cls <- if (i == 1) 'class="buffy-dot active"' else 'class="buffy-dot"'
    cat(sprintf('    <span %s onclick="buffyGoTo(%d)"></span>\n', cls, i - 1))
  }
  cat('  </div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')

  cat(sprintf('
<script>
(function() {
  var current = 0;
  var total = %d;
  var timer;

  function show(n) {
    var slides = document.querySelectorAll(".buffy-slide");
    var dots   = document.querySelectorAll(".buffy-dot");
    slides[current].classList.remove("active");
    dots[current].classList.remove("active");
    current = ((n %% total) + total) %% total;
    slides[current].classList.add("active");
    dots[current].classList.add("active");
  }

  function auto() {
    timer = setTimeout(function() { show(current + 1); auto(); }, 3000);
  }

  window.buffyNext  = function() { clearTimeout(timer); show(current + 1); auto(); };
  window.buffyPrev  = function() { clearTimeout(timer); show(current - 1); auto(); };
  window.buffyGoTo  = function(n) { clearTimeout(timer); show(n); auto(); };

  auto();
})();
</script>\n', length(photos)))
}
```
